purpose: Three-way aggregate comparison of the frozen #20 rule extractor, #23 local-LLM extractor, and #24-audited public label dataset over the non-gold cohort. Evidence only: no correctness claim, no source selection, no activation decision, no training artifact.

public_descriptive_columns.{target}: score domain frequencies recorded descriptively only
public_descriptive_columns.{target}__conf: confidence domain frequencies recorded descriptively only

cohorts.definition: gold iff all twelve organizer target columns are present; non_gold iff all twelve are absent; any other pattern is rejected

join.expected_complete_triples_per_cohort_row: one triple per non-gold study-target with all three sources present

strata.partition: every complete triple lands in exactly one stratum

definitions.triple-decisive-agree: all three sources decisive with identical polarity
definitions.pairwise-agree-third-opposes: all three decisive; two share one polarity and the remaining source holds the opposite polarity
definitions.pairwise-agree-third-abstains: exactly two decisive sources sharing one polarity; the third source is non-decisive
definitions.two-decisive-opposed: exactly two decisive sources with opposite polarities; the third is non-decisive
definitions.single-decisive-only: exactly one decisive source; split by source and polarity

strata.standoff_note: with only two polarities across three binary votes a three-way polarity standoff is impossible; an all-decisive triple is either unanimous or a 2-versus-1 split

crosscut.any-uncertain: triples containing at least one rules-or-LLM uncertain state; counted in addition to the partition

strata.contested_definition: for quota-feasibility description only: a candidate sits in pairwise-agree-third-opposes or two-decisive-opposed, i.e. another source casts an opposing decisive vote

pairwise_method.joint_decisive_comparison: compared rows require both members decisive; identical to #24's compared-decisive methodology
pairwise_method.exact_state_agreement: four-state equality over every overlapping row; identical to #23's exact-agreement methodology
pairwise_method.reconciliation_scope: rates and counts are computed on the 4,349-study non-gold cohort; #23 published over 4,407 rows and #24 over the 4,406-row public overlap, so published numbers reconcile by methodology and differ only by cohort

directions: public-negative/rule-positive with the LLM vote distribution
public-positive/rule-negative with the LLM vote distribution

oa_coverage_expansion.contents: decisive counts by source, LLM-positive/public-positive overlap, and the LLM-only and public-only decisive pools

under_calling_profile.flag_threshold: flag a target when LLM decisive positives fall below 25% of another source's decisive positives

parse_loss.scope: non-gold rows of parse-failed LLM studies
parse_loss.counterfactual: decisive counts the rules and public sources supply on rows where the LLM emitted parse-failure unknown

quota_feasibility.purpose: informative evidence for the #21 rewrite only; selects no design, threshold, or priority

outputs.privacy_rule: no study identifier, patient identifier, report text, report hash, or row-level label may appear in any retrieved artifact
